statement: The recorded flight-out date of 16 March is not safe or correct, as it falls after the conference (12–15 March) and after Dana's talk on the morning of 13 March. I'll book the flight out for 12 March instead so she arrives in time.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "the recorded flight-out date of 16 March is not safe or correct" because it falls after the conference and her talk, and supplies the corrected date.
